answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 35580 Country: India Title: I wanted to ask if we can dye the clothes, I had given one burqa to dye from blue to black to my laundry wala. I wanted to ask can wash 3 times and then wear it. Question: I wanted to ask if we can dye the clothes, I had given one burqa to dye from blue to black to my laundry wala. I wanted to ask can wash 3 times and then wear it. Answer ID: 35580 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2011/1626/B=1432) A burqa does not get impure by colouring it from blue to black colour. However if you wash it as precaution then it is good. You can wear it after washing it thrice. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
